items.headline: UTEP hosts San Jose State in MWC matchup
items.description: San Jose State (3-3) at UTEP (1-5), Oct. 17 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Erik Sandvik makes FG in OT as Wyoming beats San Jose State 16-13 to snap 8-game road losing streak
items.description: — Tyler Hughes threw for a touchdown and ran for 92 yards, Erik Sandvik made a short field goal in overtime and Wyoming beat San Jose State 16-13 on Friday night to snap an eight-game road losing streak.

items.headline: San Jose State hosts Wyoming in MWC play
items.description: Wyoming (2-3) at San Jose State (3-2), Oct. 9 at 9 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Weaver throws 2 TD passes, San Jose State wins 6th straight against Hawaii, 20-16
items.description: — Luke Weaver was 19-of-28 passing for 246 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions and San Jose State beat Hawaii 20-16 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Hawaii hosts San Jose State in MWC play
items.description: San Jose State (2-2) at Hawaii (1-3), Oct. 3 at 11:59 p.m. EDT.
